capabilities: Measure a readability grade against a user-set floor and ceiling per note or vault
Visualize sentence-length rhythm with per-sentence bars and flag flat paragraphs
Flag filler words, adverbs, weak verbs, close word repeats, and showy dialogue tags
Compare a note's grade, sentence length, variety, and habits against other notes in its folder
Toggle between Write mode (marks hidden) and Edit mode (marks shown)
extras: The plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, uses no AI or network calls, and is licensed under GNU AGPL v3 or later; the README links to GitHub issues and Buy me a coffee for feedback and support.
problem: Most readability tools push every sentence toward a lower grade, which does not suit fiction or essays where a long sentence can be intentional.
summary: Rule-based writing coach that measures readability grade, sentence rhythm, and word habits in notes and points them out without rewriting.
